description.value: San Remo Pizza is a family-run Italian restaurant that has been serving the Tri-Cities (Port Coquitlam area) since 1985, winning recognition for its award-winning pizza made with homemade crust and sauce. The 100-seat dining room offers a broad menu of Italian classics including lasagna, pasta, and flame-tableside dishes, alongside a full bar and wine list. Cyclists looking for a substantial sit-down meal or a takeout order in the Port Coquitlam area will find a well-established local institution here.
